title: Money stealing
body:
Don’t ever try this app!!!
I paid for 1 week subscription 2,99€ and cancelled at the same day because I didn’t like it at all. Then after that,this apo tried 3 times to take money for me(2,99€)  for another subscription, but at that moment I didn’t have any money on my card. I wrote them a message to inform them that I already cancelled the subscription, and surprise after few weeks they took form me 14,99 € for a month subscription and gonna take for the nect month 28,99€..like what ?? At the end I had to block my account ,so they can not take my money..
author: radatimush
